subject: Rate guarantee with staged ramp credits for renewal
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northstar.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@northstar.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal: multi-year rate anchor + staged ramp credits

Hi Liam / Priya,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week — really appreciate the transparency on projected growth and the traffic seasonality. Attached is a commercial proposal that should address both parties' goals: lock a predictable per-token rate for three years while giving NorthStar flexibility to ramp usage without overcommitting cash up-front. Key points (summary):

- Term: 3 years (2027-2029) with annual true-ups
- Pricing anchor: $0.0040 / token for covered generation calls when prepay commitments are met
- Staged prepay (annual): Year 1 = 5M tokens prepaid, Year 2 = 8M, Year 3 = 12M
- Rollover / credit bank: unused prepaid tokens may be rolled forward subject to a cap (see SOW)
- Overage: discounted incremental tier at $0.0048 / token when annual consumption > prepaid amount
- Safety: 60-day termination notice for material product changes; standard refund rules for unused credits in Year 1 only (per SOW)

I attached a rate matrix and draft SOW (see attachments). The structure is designed to: (1) cap your per-token cost vs market movements, (2) give you headroom to ramp, and (3) provide Redwood predictability for capacity planning.

If this looks directionally right, I can loop in Marcus (capacity/ops) and Rishi (discount approvals) to finalize the ramp bands and any technical SLAs we'll include. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the numbers.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick call (30m) this week to confirm Year 1 anchor and rollover cap
- Finalize SOW and pricing matrix
- Customer PO for Year 1 prepay to lock pricing

Attachments: rate_matrix_northstar.xlsx (pricing scenarios), NS_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (draft SOW)

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northstar.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: multi-year rate anchor + staged ramp credits

Monica —

Thanks for the proposal and the clear summary. A few quick items from our side:

- We like the concept of a rate anchor but we're hesitant to prepay a large fixed amount without more flexibility if our product roadmap shifts.
- Can you do an annual prepay (rather than year-by-year locked amounts) with the option to increase mid-year?
- What protections exist if our usage falls materially below the prepaid amount — would we be able to reclaim credits or get refunds?
- Legal will want the price guarantee scoped tightly to the services in the SOW (no surprise add-ons).

Priya (cc) — can you confirm what your finance/PO timeline looks like if we agree to Year 1 prepay?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to take the call after we get the rollover and refund mechanics clarified.

Best,
Liam
VP Product, NorthStar Analytics
liam.oconnor@northstar.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northstar.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: multi-year rate anchor + staged ramp credits

Thanks Liam — good questions. Quick answers and a refined proposal option:

- Annual prepay option: yes. We can structure as an annual prepay with an option to top-up mid-year. That preserves the price anchor while limiting Year 1 cash exposure.
- Flexibility if usage drops: proposal A (conservative) allows unused credits to roll forward up to 25% of the prepaid amount into the next year; proposal B (more flexible) allows up to 50% roll-forward but requires a slightly higher base price.
- Refunds: we generally avoid cash refunds on prepay; instead we use a credit bank model (roll-forward / offset against future usage). For Year 1 only we can allow a partial refund clause (up to 10% of Year 1 prepay) if NorthStar terminates for convenience within 90 days — this is to protect both sides.
- SOW scoping: we will bind the price guarantee to the services listed in the attached SOW and exclude add-ons/third-party fees unless mutually agreed.

Looping in Marcus to confirm the capacity reservation / SLO language and to give an example of how a staged ramp would map to reserved GPU/throughput. Rishi — we may need a discretionary discount approval if NorthStar selects the 50% roll-forward option.

If you'd like, we can prepare two side-by-side options (Annual Anchor — conservative vs Annual Anchor — flexible) and run the numbers on a call.

Cheers,
Monica
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northstar.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@northstar.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: multi-year rate anchor + staged ramp credits

Hi all — quick technical / ops notes to make the commercial terms executable:

- Capacity reservation mapping: think of the prepaid commitment as a reservation for a baseline throughput profile (e.g., 60% of peak burst capacity in Y1). We convert token commitments into an equivalent GPU-hour reservation for scheduling.
- Ramp example (how we mapped the staged tokens to capacity):
  - Year 1 prepaid 5M tokens -> equivalent to ~120 GPU-hours/month baseline (est; depends on model/seq length)
  - Year 2 prepaid 8M tokens -> ~190 GPU-hours/month baseline
  - Year 3 prepaid 12M tokens -> ~285 GPU-hours/month baseline
- Overage handling: burst above the reserved baseline will draw from the credit bank first, then be billed at the overage rate. If credits exhausted, overage billed at discounted incremental tier.
- Rollover mechanics: technical limitation is that credits are tied to the customer account and can be consumed across projects in the same org; we can support roll-forward up to 50% but need to flag long-tail accounting complexity (we'll need to track per-quarter true-ups).

Attached is a worked scenario (rate_matrix_northstar.xlsx) showing monthly billing under different ramp shapes and the effective token rate after credits / batching.

Happy to join a numbers call and walk through 2-3 real traffic scenarios so you can pick the option that minimizes cash risk.

—Marcus
Principal, Infrastructure & Capacity | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@northstar.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northstar.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@northstar.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: multi-year rate anchor + staged ramp credits

Monica / Marcus —

Quick notes from legal as we review the draft SOW and the commercial term sheet:

1) Please ensure the price protection clause is narrowly scoped to the services defined in the SOW (generation & embeddings for the specified model family). Exclude third-party LLM licenses, marketplace fees, and future add-on modules.
2) We need explicit audit & evidence commitments: SOC 2 report, access to per-token audit logs for one-year retention, and the ability to request capacity planning reports quarterly.
3) Rollover cap: 50% roll-forward seems high — we'd like to see a conservative cap (25%) and a true-up mechanism at year-end. If you insist on 50%, we need a stronger refund/mitigation clause.
4) Please provide a DocuSign-ready SOW and an outline of refund mechanics for early termination.

Can you share the latest SOW with the requested evidence links and a redline of the commercial terms? Once we have that, legal can circulate a redline and we should be able to move to signature.

Thanks,
Sanjay Gupta
General Counsel | NorthStar Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@northstar.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northstar.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@northstar.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: multi-year rate anchor + staged ramp credits

Sanjay / Liam / Priya —

Thanks for the redline requests. We've discussed internally and propose the following final commercial positions to unblock signature this week:

- Term: 3 years with annual prepay option and annual true-up.
- Price guarantee: limited to generation + embedding calls using the model families listed in Section 2 of the attached SOW. Add-ons & third-party fees explicitly excluded.
- Rollover / credits: unused prepaid tokens may be rolled forward up to 25% of the prior year's prepay amount (compromise from earlier).
- Refunds / termination: Year 1 only — up to 10% refund of Year 1 prepay if NorthStar terminates for convenience within 90 days; otherwise credit bank rules apply.
- Evidence & audit: we'll provide SOC 2 report (latest), per-token audit logs for 12 months, and quarterly capacity reports. We will include a schedule listing the evidence links in the SOW.
- Discount: in exchange for the 3-year anchor and the annual prepay schedule, Redwood will apply a 12% discount off list for covered usage.

Next steps I propose from Redwood:
1) I will upload a DocuSign-ready SOW with the agreed clauses to the shared drive and send the signing link by EOD. (Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/NS/renewal/attachments)
2) Finance: Priya, if you can confirm PO timing we will reserve Year 1 capacity upon receipt.
3) Ops: Marcus will schedule an onboarding checkpoint after signature to map token commitments to reserved GPU hours.

If everyone is aligned I will route the SOW for signature and loop in our finance team for invoicing.

Thanks — appreciate the collaborative approach on this.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
